subject: A sourcing contact for the whole equipment brief
preheader: Introducing Supply Ministry: practical help with options, trials and coordinated quotes.
intro: I am David from Supply Ministry. We help occupational therapists and care teams source and coordinate assistive technology across equipment categories.
If we have not worked together, a useful way to start is with a practical requirement that needs more than a product link.
body: That might involve a hoist and commode, mobility equipment and room access, or several items that need to be considered alongside a trial or delivery arrangement.

You bring the functional requirements and clinical direction. We can help explore sourcing options, identify what still needs checking and bring the equipment requirements into a coordinated quote discussion.

Exact suitability, compatibility, availability and trial arrangements need to be confirmed for each brief. A clear picture of the person’s goals and practical constraints is a better starting point than an assumed package.
actionTitle: Send the question before the shopping list
actionText: Reply with two or three de-identified lines about what needs to be organised. We can discuss the requirement and whether Supply Ministry is the right fit to help.
